name: firefly/security
description: LaraFly security core: a first-party immutable SecurityContext/Authentication principal model, in-memory + JWT + OAuth2 resource-server authentication, deny-by-default URL and method authorization (#[PreAuthorize]/#[Secured]/#[RolesAllowed]) enforced at the CQRS bus + controller dispatch via a single reflection-free method-security manifest and a no-eval whitelist expression evaluator, CSRF + security-headers hardening filters, and real CommandAuthorizer/QueryAuthorizer/AuditorAware/ControllerSecurityGuard seam implementations. Secure-by-default, fail-closed, zero boot reflection.
